name: Barco UDX-4K32
lumens_note: ANSI lumens in 4K UHD mode (30,000 in WQ mode)

lenses.name: TLD+ 0.65-0.85 UST 90° (R9862001)
lenses.note: Sold as 0.65-0.85, but that range is for WUXGA. Barco lists 0.71-0.93 for WQ/4K UHD. The beam leaves at 90° to the body. Lens shift: use Barco's lens calculator.

lenses.name: TLD+ 1.49-2.03 (WQ/4K UHD)
lenses.note: Listed by Barco as 1.39-1.89 for WU/HD and 1.49-2.03 for WQ/4K UHD. Lens shift: use Barco's lens calculator.

note: Lens shift on the UDX depends on the lens (vertical -100% to +130%, horizontal up to ±40%), so no shift limits are set.
